ns2:section.sectionText: Race/Ethnicity We invite you to join us in this interactive course designed to discuss topics centered around race, culture, stereotypes, social privilege, macroaggressions etc. We encourage students to bring their own unique experiences, perspectives, and stories to the classroom to inform our dialogue.” Meets 21 March 2022- 4-May-2022. OIIR Dialogue Course. 1 Hour (letter-graded) credit. Topic: Race/Ethnicity, Second half session class. Offered in collaboration with the Office of Inclusion and Intercultural Relations (OIIR) For detailed course descriptions see http://go.illinois.edu/EPSY203. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can email diversityed@illinois.edu.
